scope: Documentation-only retrospective of assigned middle performance attempts; no execution, builds, deployment, or process control performed. Performance goal remains paused.

attempts.name: Internal event profiling / unavailable Nsight trace
attempts.mechanism: Optional CUDA event spans plus CPU phase counters after Nsight Systems could not initialize its Windows tracing provider.
findings: Nsight Systems required Windows administrator privileges for ReflexStatsTraceLoggingProvider; no Nsight trace was produced. Existing internal events were used instead.

First 16 decode batches: CPU fused 2137.64 ms, GPU cached 282.39 ms, entry wait 215.25 ms, readback wait 777.03 ms; 25,521 CPU expert jobs / 35,720 selections. Prefill copy interval 8848.56 ms, streamed expert interval 4836.38 ms.
caveats: Intervals overlap; these numbers are not serial addends or a production speed comparison.

attempts.name: Initial CUDA graph spans
attempts.mechanism: Attempted replay of GPU-only spans around hybrid CPU expert operations.
attempts.status: superseded; original graph warmup did not establish useful replay
findings: Debug log repeatedly reports CUDA graph warmup reset. Saved rates were 468.07 / 13.72 and debug 482.45 / 13.71 tok/s. Those runs are observations, not evidence of a graph speedup.
Later hybrid-span-graphs is a separate implementation with captured/replayed counters and controlled on/off comparisons.
retained_evidence: core-engine/ggml/src/ggml-cuda/ggml-cuda.cu rejects whole graphs containing CPU dispatch/readback.
caveats: No contemporaneous same-binary on/off control or dedicated original-spans rollback receipt identified.
Profile/debug modes and graph warmup can change timing.

attempts.name: Custom IQ kernel for singleton groups
attempts.mechanism: Extend grouped AVX 2 IQ 2/IQ 3/IQ 4 kernels to one activation row instead of the established single-row vector dot.
findings: 503.31 prefill / 12.57 generation tok/s. First-16 gate/up 1285.87 ms and down 693.54 ms across 21,004 jobs. Deployment for dual-layer prefill explicitly says revert slower singleton CPU path.
retained_evidence: core-engine/ggml/src/ggml-cpu/moe.cpp: custom compute_group requires group.count > 1; singleton retains matrix.row.
caveats: No isolated same-binary singleton-disabled control found; later runs also changed cache capacity and prefill mechanics. Do not infer an isolated regression percentage.

attempts.name: Replace host event wait by stream dependency
attempts.mechanism: Replace per-layer host event wait with stream dependency before required IDs/input readback, preserving metadata lifetime.
attempts.status: rejected; measured host event wait restored
findings: 493.98 prefill / 12.05 generation. Decode entry wait becomes 0 but readback wait is 1621.64 ms; CPU fused 1679.08 ms. Prefill readback 10832.62 ms. Removing one reported wait did not prove reduced total dependency cost.
rollback_or_cleanup_evidence: fused-bulk-gate-up-deployment.json explicitly restores measured host event wait.
caveats: No matched on/off comparison receipt found. Fused-bulk successor changes a separate mechanism.

attempts.name: Actual frequencies / retrospective capacity
attempts.mechanism: Collect expert frequencies to distinguish cache policy loss from finite capacity; simulate fixed and unequal capacities using already observed routing.
attempts.status: diagnostic; optional counters disabled in normal serving
findings: Observed 35,720 selections; actual hits 17,056 (47.75%); best fixed-capacity hindsight 24,606 (68.89%); greedy globally allocated capacity 24,779 (69.37%) at 8192 MiB. Unequal allocation adds about 0.48 percentage points over fixed hindsight.
This profile ran 511.53 / 11.60 tok/s; it is not a speed improvement. Retrospective best hits are not future predictions.
retained_evidence: production-baseline-deployment.json restores baseline admission/decode, retaining optional diagnostics disabled in production.
caveats: Do not use past-window routing as an oracle or claim an attainable future 69% hit rate. Compact decode slot packing and cost-aware admission have distinct receipts covered elsewhere.

attempts.name: Prefill transfer/compute timeline
attempts.mechanism: Timestamp weight-copy and expert-compute intervals on their streams and compute interval unions/overlap.
attempts.status: diagnostic; detailed timeline archived and disabled
findings: Prefill span 11546.474 ms; copy union 6768.128 ms; expert union 4070.433 ms; overlap only 81.824 ms. Located a pipeline serialization issue rather than proving an SSD issue.
503.31 / 12.49 tok/s with tracing.
rollback_or_cleanup_evidence: checkpoint-core8k-after-transfer-timeline.json restores normal source/binary; timeline source archived as candidates/moe-hybrid-transfer-timeline.cu.
caveats: Intervals include queue gaps and exclude other GPU operations. Union does not equal exact SM busy time.

attempts.name: Mapped prefill routing metadata
attempts.mechanism: Stage routing IDs/entries with a kernel reading existing pinned host arrays, avoiding small H 2 D metadata copies behind lookahead weight uploads; ordinary-copy fallback without unified addressing.
findings: Unprofiled sequential controls: 509.66 / 12.22 before, 596.44 / 12.04 after; prefill +17.03%, generation -1.44% observed.
Profiled transfer/expert overlap grows 81.824 to 1986.336 ms while copy union stays about 6768 ms; pipeline span 11546.474 to 9660.932 ms. Profiled candidate rate 579.76 / 11.75.
retained_evidence: core-engine/ggml/src/ggml-cuda/moe-hybrid.cu has mapped_metadata / stage_prefill_metadata and copy fallback.
checkpoint-core8k-span-evaluation.json lists retained CPU-result handoff and prefill pipeline.
caveats: Cold server runs; same request/parameters, different builds and draft acceptance. One production observation per configuration with clocks unlocked. No isolated generation gain.

attempts.name: Target attention timeline
attempts.mechanism: Timestamp target attention by head count to locate slow sliding-window work.
findings: 12 full-attention calls (48 heads) total 369.218 ms; 36 sliding-window calls (72 heads) total 2042.002 ms, mean 56.722 ms. All target attention total 2411.220 ms.
582.01 / 12.20 tok/s with timeline.
caveats: Contains KV conversion and queue gaps; excludes draft feature injection. No causal speedup claimed.

attempts.name: Prefill attention lower mask bounds
attempts.mechanism: Find first unmasked tiles and skip exact fully masked ranges in stream-K sliding-window attention, preserving mask/window/positions/KV.
findings: Normal sequential measurement: 596.44 / 12.04 to 674.28 / 12.51 tok/s; +13.05% prefill and +3.89% generation observed.
Profiled sliding-window attention 2042.002 to 412.767 ms; total attention 2411.220 to 794.062 ms. Profiled candidate 648.09 / 11.52.
retained_evidence: checkpoint-core8k-span-evaluation.json lists Flash-attention prefill and decode mask bounds.
core-engine/ggml/src/ggml-cuda/fattn-common.cuh carries prefill mask lower/upper bound logic.
caveats: Different builds, draft acceptance and clocks; generation delta is not an isolated causal measurement. One 8 k request only.

attempts.name: GPU wait for CPU / DFlash cost
attempts.mechanism: Measure GPU interval after cached GPU experts finish until CPU expert results, alongside draft timing.
findings: First 16 verification batches / 752 layer calls / 76 target evaluations per layer: CPU fused 1672.09 ms; GPU waiting for CPU 1001.18 ms; cached GPU 668.57 ms; readback 1343.38 ms; entry 240.63 ms; host prepare 358.91 ms.
25 draft rounds total 359.409 ms, 5.32% of total generation time; draft prefill feature injection 584.22 ms for 892 rows, 7168 rows skipped.
717.15 / 11.83 tok/s. Cache already has per-target-token exponential recency.
caveats: First-16 target counters do not cover all 25 draft rounds; counters overlap. This is diagnostic, not optimization.

attempts.name: Bounded mapped CPU completion/results
attempts.mechanism: Mapped pinned CPU results with GPU completion poll capped at 10 ms per block; unfinished blocks handled by second reduction launch after CPU completion.
findings: Same-source/binary profiled + DebugGpu control: 737.23 / 11.83 off versus 719.20 / 13.08 on; generation +10.56%, 646.282 ms saved. Actual generated 80-token arrays and draft 100/53 match.
Coarse decode-loaded telemetry median SM 1335 to 1530 MHz, memory 8751 MHz both; more P 2 samples. These samples are not exact per-token intervals.
Production bundled follow-up (also DFlash window trimming): 674.28 / 12.51 to 718.08 / 14.03. Bundle deltas are not solely handoff effect.
retained_evidence: core-engine/ggml/src/ggml-cuda/moe-hybrid.cu sets GGML_CUDA_MOE_CPU_DOORBELL default1 if unified addressing.
caveats: One run per condition, clocks unlocked, cache trajectories differ even with matching tokens. Full API and 128 k unverified.

attempts.name: CPU attention mask construction measurement
attempts.mechanism: Measure large-batch mask fill with existing profiling to distinguish CPU preparation from GPU attention.
findings: Two mask fills: 268.059 ms full attention + 268.174 ms SWA = 536.233 ms. Prompt bulk graph evaluates 8060 of request 8064 tokens.
720.57 / 14.19 tok/s; measurement led to contiguous range fill.
rollback_or_cleanup_evidence: candidates/llama-kv-cache-mask-timing.cpp preserves instrumentation; contiguous-mask successor contains optional profile path.
caveats: No improvement implied by adding counters.

attempts.name: Exact contiguous prefill mask range fill
attempts.mechanism: After checking single-sequence contiguous KV positions and empty padding, use exact causal/window bounds and fill contiguous ranges; retain generic path for other layouts.
findings: Profiled fill 536.233 to 27.114 ms, reduction 94.94%; prefill 720.57 to 754.45 tok/s (+4.70%); generation 14.19 to 13.69.
Normal follow-up 718.08/14.03 to 775.16/14.49. Range-fill applies only to prefill; do not attribute generation delta to it.
retained_evidence: checkpoint-core8k-span-evaluation.json lists retained contiguous prefill construction.
caveats: Mask control and candidate draft counts 96/55 versus 96/54; production 96/55 versus 93/54. Actual outputs differ. Clocks unlocked.
SWA allocator already supports compact sizing min(base cells,window+ubatch), padded 256 unless swa_full; never claim always full 128 k allocation.

attempts.name: Mapped GPU-to-CPU input publication
attempts.mechanism: Publish activations/routing to mapped host arrays to avoid separate entry/readback handoff waits.
findings: On 750.90/15.04 versusoff 773.78/14.28 tok/s. Apparent generation rise accompanies 88/57 versus 93/54 draft/accepted and different output arrays.
Equal 752 calls and 76 target evals/layer: on combined entry+readback 1175.48 ms versusoff 1171.74 ms; CPU 1765.59 versus 1628.72 ms; prepare 307.23 versus 267.91 ms. No isolated gain.
rollback_or_cleanup_evidence: input-publication-revert.json records matching restored C/E source hash and original CUDA DLL; candidate archived candidates/moe-hybrid-input-publication.cu.
caveats: One run per mode, clocks/cache trajectories differ. GPU-to-CPU waiting includes preceding attention/dense GPU work.

attempts.name: Host launch / GPU readback span profiling
attempts.mechanism: Measure host work inside/outside hybrid dispatch and GPU between-MoE/readback/attention intervals; optional profile-only with no new stream synchronization.
attempts.status: diagnostic; optional counters retained inactive in normal serving
findings: First 16 verification batches:752 hybrid nodes,76 target evals/layer,23,776 ordinary dispatches,12,112 fused nodes. Host insidehybrid 3201.74 ms; outside 433.18 ms. CPU 1695.32 ms, GPU attention 609.37 ms, between-MoE 1149.14 ms.
755.45/13.42 tok/s. This directed attention-bounds and graph-section investigation.
retained_evidence: core-engine/ggml/src/ggml-cuda/ggml-cuda.cu and moe-hybrid.cu guard readback spans on profile+GGML_CUDA_MOE_PROFILE_READBACK_SPAN.
caveats: Outside-hybrid includes bookkeeping/fusion, not just kernel launches. Attention overlaps between-MoE span; CPU/GPU overlap.

attempts.name: Stream-K small-batch decode mask bounds
attempts.mechanism: Exact masked-tile bounds for small batches, ignore padded query rows and skip only negative infinity; vector attention 1/2-query path unchanged.
findings: Same CUDA binary: on 755.09/14.63 versusoff 779.30/13.79. First 16 attention 607.97?222.12 ms (-63.47%), readback 962.27?555.75 ms, between-MoE 1127.62?769.72 ms at equal 752 calls/76 evals.
Output arrays differ; accepted 53 each but draft 97 vs 100. CPU 1758.43 on vs 1611.18 off. Observed+6.04% generation is not isolated causality.
Normal follow-up 775.16/14.49 to 749.28/14.60 (+0.79% generation), different binaries/acceptance.
caveats: One fresh-server run per mode; clocks unlocked. Profile adds overhead. Preceding launch-span baseline had identical outputs but predates padded-query guard; it is not same-binary control.

attempts.name: Caller placement first sampler
attempts.mechanism: Sample caller on primary logical-processor masks before gate/up and after down, record worker pin status.
findings: 15 worker affinity successes, 0 failures are valid. Raw 1504 samples:2 worker,349 reserved; totals miss sibling logical processors so physical contention cannot be inferred.
rollback_or_cleanup_evidence: Original primary-only sampler archived candidates/moe-caller-primary-sampling.cpp; replaced by corrected sibling masks.
caveats: Incomplete physical-core samples and no time weighting.

attempts.name: Caller placement corrected sampler
attempts.mechanism: Count both logical siblings for physical-core sampling without changing worker affinity/numerical work.
findings: 1504 samples: 924 worker cores, 580 reserved (61.44% worker); 15 worker affinity successes, 0 failures.758.85/14.37 tok/s.
Sample boundaries suggest possible caller overlap, leading to scoped affinity comparison; no time-weighted contention conclusion.
retained_evidence: core-engine/ggml/src/ggml-cpu/moe.cpp and caller-affinity-rollback.json retain corrected placement source.
caveats: Sampling records placement at two boundaries, not elapsed CPU contention.

attempts.name: Scoped caller pin to reserved physical core
attempts.mechanism: Pin caller to reserved physical core only during CPU expert phases; restore prior affinity on normal/exception return.
findings: Same CPU/CUDA binaries: on 762.33/15.35 versusoff 778.58/15.58; generation -1.44% observed. CPU fused 1707.52 on versus 1595.58 off. All 1504 enabled caller samples reserved but no improvement.
Restored normal engine 780.38/16.09 is a state validation measurement, not an affinity gain.
caveats: Different outputs and 95/54 vs 100/53 draft/accepted; disabled unbound placement varies between launches; samples are not time weighted.

attempts.name: CUDA graph slice build attempt
attempts.mechanism: GPU-only graph replay between CPU expert calls; first used internal ggml_graph_view then local slice preserving parent dependency counts.
attempts.status: first build failed; repaired before measured candidate
findings: Windows link failure: ggml_graph_view is internal/nonexported. Archived unexported-view candidate. Build exit-1 produced no speed measurement. Local graph slice subsequently compiled.
caveats: A failed build has no throughput result.

attempts.name: GPU-only section graph capture/replay
attempts.mechanism: Reuse graph warmup/property checks/dependency counts and direct fallback for GPU-only spans around CPU experts.
findings: Same binaries, profile: on 763.89/15.07 vs off 779.10/15.57. Ordinary dispatch 23,776?5944 (-75%); host outsidehybrid 401.45?250.11 ms (-37.70%);576 replayed spans,48 captures. CPU 1781.26 on vs 1611.02 off; no total gain.
Same binaries unprofiled: on 778.30/15.67 vs off 779.18/16.07 (-2.52% generation observed).
Attention event timing excludes captured/replayed operations; apparent 48.1 ms versus 216.09 ms is missing coverage, not faster attention.
rollback_or_cleanup_evidence: checkpoint-core8k-span-evaluation.json restored production, profileoff/readbackoff, candidate removed.
caveats: Outputs/draft acceptance/placement/cachemisses differ bothpairs. Faster host dispatch alone does not prove higher throughput.

attempts.name: CPU worker phase drain timings
attempts.mechanism: Measure per-phase wall time, longest worker drain and union/span of active workers without changing jobs/kernels.
findings: Wall across gate/up, down quantization and down: 1697.30 ms; active drain span 1692.84 ms, outside 4.46 ms (0.263%). Gate/up 1033.78 wall,1031.77 span; down 643.64 wall,642.41 span.764.10/15.86 tok/s.
Wakeup/phase-boundary gap is too small in this measurement to be the primary target. Active drain includes atomics, dots, decoding, activation math andmemory stalls.
rollback_or_cleanup_evidence: paired-gate-up-rollback.json removes temporary per-worker instrumentation, source restored4D86859...
caveats: Parallel longest/union intervals are not independent latency addends; varying callerplacement/acceptance.

attempts.name: Paired IQ 2 gate/up first kernel
attempts.mechanism: Compute gate and up together to share quantized activation loads/sign work without changing selected experts/weights.
attempts.status: rejected first form; register rewrite tried
findings: Same binaries on 752.03/15.64 vs off 780.07/16.94; -7.66% generation observed. Gate/up 1032.74 on vs 929.85 off; CPU 1761.39 vs 1627.09 ms.
Assembly spills accumulators/scales to stack; activation reads folded separately intoXORs, so intended sharing was not realized.
rollback_or_cleanup_evidence: Initial source preserved then superseded by registers candidate; paired-gate-up-rollback.json restores both.
caveats: Outputs and 92/55 vs 92/56 acceptance differ; caller worker overlap also differs. Not an isolated kernel speed percentage.

attempts.name: Paired IQ 2 gate/up register-lifetime rewrite
attempts.mechanism: Shorten live ranges / explicitly reuse activation registers in paired gate/up AVX 2 calculation.
findings: Assembly now reuses YMM 8/YMM 10 for both VPSIGNB and YMM 11/12 accumulators. Same binaries on 754.83/14.45 vs off 779.52/15.57; -7.18% generation observed.
Gate/up 1025.68 on vs 1005.28 off; CPU 1740.28 on vs 1701.03 off. Corrected register reuse didnot establish gain.
rollback_or_cleanup_evidence: paired-gate-up-rollback.json restores retained CPUthree sources/binary; source timestamps force candidate objects to recompile onnext incremental build.
caveats: Output arrays,100/53 vs 96/54 draft/accepted, placement/cachetrajectories differ. Source preserves standard floatingpointorder but no standalone equivalence test was authored.

attempts.name: Expanded exact IQ 2 CPU cache (144 bytes/block)
attempts.mechanism: Decode IQ 2 grid/sign payload once at model load into expanded immutable CPU mirror; retain scale/quantized values and original GPU weights.
findings: Expanded block: 144 bytes versus original 82. Additional 38.8125 GiB for 92 tensors; preparation 17797.24 ms before requests; free RAM 28.55 GiB after request.

Same CPU/CUDA/llama binaries: on 742.72/13.13 vs off 783.67/16.85. First 16 scheduledweight payload 71190.84 vs 50577.87 MiB; gate/up 1412.88 vs 959.00 ms; CPU 2191.80 vs 1685.29 ms.18141 predecoded selections.
Removing lookups increased CPUphase cost and weight payload. This is distinct from later lossless 328-byte four-row R 4 packing.
rollback_or_cleanup_evidence: iq2-weight-cache-rollback.json restores all six sourcefiles plus original CPU/CUDA/llama/server binaries; rejected-iq2-cache-* archives.
caveats: Outputs 100/53 vs 86/56 draft/accepted andcallerplacement differ. Scheduledbytes are not measured DRAM traffic; cannot isolate instruction vsbandwidth vsTLB causes.

attempts.name: Direct SM clock hold attempt
attempts.mechanism: Request 2400..3120 MHz GPU clock lock using nvidia-smi.
findings: Exit 4: current user does not have permission to change clocks. No successful clock hold / no performance comparison.
caveats: Do not characterize any subsequent normal run as a clock-held run. No administrator helper launched by this documentation task.

attempts.name: Temporary per-application NVIDIA max-performance policy
attempts.mechanism: Create an NVAPI application profile for the exact Laguna server path, set prefer maximum performance, read back, then measure the existing request.
findings: Before: exact server application profile not found (-166); applied: power_value 1 readback; measurement 523.90/12.26 tok/s. Decode remained P 3 at roughly 900 MHz incheckpoint interpretation.

Restoration readback again found no exact application (-166) and no base power setting (-160), matching the absent profile before. This policy differs from a successful clock lock, which never occurred.
caveats: No same-binary paired performance control established for policy; generation variation cannot isolate causal power effect. The cause of desktop application windows closing remains unexplained.
